terms.label: methodology
terms.definition: The document describing the method actually applied to produce a dataset or data package: sources, acquisition, processing and limitations. Unlike prov:hadPlan, it is documentation of what was done, not a plan of intent attached to an activity. Unlike schema:measurementTechnique, it covers the whole resource, not the measurement of one variable.

terms.label: SHA-256 of imported source file
terms.definition: Full file hash on the import-source prov:Entity. Distinct from vocab:dataHash, which hashes just the data content on a Distribution.

terms.label: Iceberg snapshot id
terms.definition: Iceberg snapshot IDs are int64; stored as decimal strings today.

terms.label: triple count
terms.definition: Number of triples visible in the graph a distribution gives access to.
